mechanism_narrative: A positive change in the number of persons employed (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in employment growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% per annum signals monetary tightening that reduces liquidity and increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS > 2.0% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous positive changes in consumer spending (RSAFS) and employment (PAYEMS) indicate robust demand conditions that drive corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal of RSAFS and PAYEMS remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of simultaneous positive RSAFS and PAYEMS changes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) indicates weakening manufacturing activity that precedes economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods with INDPRO < 100 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising CPIAUCSL are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 thousand units, it signals contraction in residential construction that reduces economic activity and consumer confidence, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of HOUST < 1300 are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a rising FEDFUNDS rate above 1.5% combined with declining INDPRO indicates contractionary policy and weakening industrial output, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal of FEDFUNDS and INDPRO remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in monetary tightening cycles with FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and INDPRO decline are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate production and profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
